query_text: How many members from different families are needed to register a primary cooperative in Punjab?

query_text: Can a member have more than one vote in a Punjab cooperative society meeting?
expected_answer: Under Section 19 of the Punjab Cooperative Societies Act 1961, every member has exactly one vote irrespective of their shareholding, enforcing the democratic principle of 'one member, one vote'. No proxy voting is allowed.
expected_evidence: Section 19: Every member of a co-operative society shall have one vote in the affairs of the society; voting by proxy is prohibited.

query_text: Can a member vote by sending an authorized proxy to the general body meeting in Punjab?
expected_answer: No. Section 19 of the Punjab Cooperative Societies Act 1961 strictly prohibits proxy voting in the affairs of the society. Members must cast their votes in person.
expected_evidence: Section 19: No member shall be permitted to vote by proxy in any cooperative society.

query_text: Where should an election dispute of a Punjab cooperative society be filed, and can we go to civil court?
expected_answer: Under Section 55 of the Punjab Cooperative Societies Act 1961, any dispute regarding the constitution, management, or elections of a society must be referred to the Registrar for arbitration. Civil courts have no jurisdiction.
expected_evidence: Section 55: If any dispute touching the constitution, management or business of a co-operative society arises... it shall be referred to the Registrar... no court shall have any jurisdiction to entertain any suit.

query_text: Does a cooperative society have a prior claim or charge on a farmer's crop for an unpaid crop loan in Punjab?
expected_answer: Under Section 48 of the Punjab Act 1961, a cooperative society has a first charge upon the crops and other agricultural produce raised by a member with loan assistance, as well as on cattle and agricultural implements purchased with such loan.
expected_evidence: Section 48: First charge of cooperative society on crops and other agricultural produce, cattle, fodder and agricultural implements.

query_text: Who is responsible for conducting managing committee elections under the Punjab Cooperative Societies Act?
expected_answer: Under Section 26 of the Punjab Act 1961, managing committee elections must be conducted in the prescribed manner by the Registrar or designated returning officer prior to the expiry of the committee term.
expected_evidence: Section 26: The superintendence, direction and control of the preparation of the electoral rolls and the conduct of elections shall be vested in the authority appointed by the State Government.

query_text: What relief does the Punjab Agriculture Development Bank One Time Settlement scheme provide for defaulters?

expected_answer: The PADB One Time Settlement (OTS) scheme allows chronic loan defaulters to settle outstanding agricultural loans by waiving penal interest and a percentage of overdue interest upon lump-sum repayment.

query_text: Can the Registrar supersede the managing committee of a cooperative society in Punjab if they fail to perform their duties?
expected_answer: Under Section 26, if a committee is in persistent default or is negligent in the performance of duties, the Registrar may supersede the committee after giving an opportunity to state objections, and appoint an Administrator.
expected_evidence: Section 26: If in the opinion of the Registrar, the committee of any cooperative society persistently makes default... the Registrar may remove the committee.

query_text: What is the maximum limit on dividend distribution to members in a Punjab cooperative society?
expected_answer: Under Punjab cooperative law, dividend distribution on paid-up share capital is capped by statutory rules (normally not exceeding 10-12% per annum) to maintain the non-profit mutual benefit nature of cooperatives.
expected_evidence: Statutory provisions on disposal of net profits and ceiling on dividend distribution.

query_text: What happens to the assets of a liquidated cooperative society in Punjab after paying all liabilities?
expected_answer: Upon liquidation and satisfaction of all creditors, remaining surplus assets are not distributed among members as profit; they are deposited in a reserve fund or transferred to a cooperative education or development fund as directed by the Registrar.
expected_evidence: Provisions regarding surplus assets upon winding up and liquidation.

query_text: What is the statutory tenure of the managing committee of a cooperative society in Haryana?

query_text: Is there a mandatory reservation of seats for women and Backward Classes on managing committees in Haryana?

query_text: Can a member challenge a managing committee decision in a civil court in Haryana?

query_text: What action can be taken against an office bearer in Haryana who misuses or embezzles society funds?
